MENTOR: I looked through **Comp 1** in *Claude AE Tutor Test*, and there's nothing for this lesson to work on: none of your keyframes are linear. All four keyframe pairs in the comp already have easing on them.

To practise, you need something that still moves at a constant speed. Here's a quick way to set one up:

1. Add a new shape or text layer (any layer works).
2. At 0 s, press **P** to show Position and click the stopwatch to set a key.
3. Go to about 1 s and drag the layer somewhere else. That creates a second key.

The new keys will be linear by default. They'll show as diamonds in the timeline, and the layer will start and stop with a hard jolt. Say **"ready"** once they're in and I'll take a look. Or, if you have another comp with some rough animation, switch to it and tell me.
